title: Forever Sprint
description: Permanently holds down your sprint key for you! Instantly run the second you move forward.
body:
# Forever Sprint
Forever Sprint is a lightweight, client-side mod that automatically keeps you sprinting whenever you move forward. No macro setups required.


### Features:
- Automatically holds the sprint key when moving forward for you.
- Follows all vanilla rules. You still cannot sprint if you are too hungry, ect.
- Highly optimized with zero impact on game performance.

### Technical Details
Client-Side Only, and runs entirely on your game instance. You can use this on any vanilla or modded server without issues.

Requirements: NeoForge (1.21.1)
